followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: I chose Willet because the request is open-ended creative writing where output quality matters most, and Willet has the highest measured creative-generation capability in the fleet (82.7 vs 79.6). The documentation explicitly states task preferences are dissociated from quality—no preference dimension affected output quality in capability evals—so Willet's low *preference* for generative work is irrelevant to how well it actually performs. Plover's strengths (warm exchanges, summarization, support dialogue) don't match this task. The user's demand for noticeably better, non-"lifeless" prose reinforces routing to the demonstrably stronger creative model.
